channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Princeton’s ‘champion of anti-racism in classics’ to leave for Arizona State U.
item.description: Dan-el Padilla Peralta, Princeton's notable advocate for anti-racism in classics, is leaving for Arizona State University in August, expressing a desire for public institution teaching. He criticized Princeton’s alignment with community values and emphasized ASU's commitment to inclusion and public service. Padilla aims to expand the study of ancient history at ASU.

item.title: ‘Happiest day of my entire life’: Venezuelan exile who warned U.S. students against socialism celebrates Maduro capture
item.description: 'God is finally giving us the opportunity to witness a measure of earthly justice through President Trump, his cabinet, and the courageous U.S. Armed Forces.'

item.title: Academics (mostly negatively) chime in on Trump Venezuela endeavor
item.description: Academics widely criticized Trump's military action in Venezuela, labeling it a violation of international law and the U.N. Charter. Experts argued it jeopardizes global norms and raises concerns about unilateral interventions. While some Venezuelans welcomed U.S. involvement, many professors deemed the invasion unconstitutional and a dangerous precedent that challenges international relations and sovereignty.

item.title: Two House bills against campus antisemitism draw bipartisan praise
item.description: These new measures aim to offer two federal responses following last year’s failure to pass the Antisemitism Awareness Act.

item.title: University of Maryland stands by security fees for Turning Point USA event
item.description: Turning Point USA was unfairly charged security fees for an event, according to the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression.

item.title: Virginia agrees to end in-state tuition for illegal immigrants to resolve DOJ lawsuit
item.description: 'Illegal immigrants cannot be given benefits that are not available to American citizens' says Virginia AG.

item.title: Harvard president admits faculty activism is a problem
item.description: Harvard President Alan Garber acknowledges the rise of political activism among faculty as problematic. He said excellent teaching once required objectivity.

item.title: No word from Trump admin on investigating claim Biden pressured schools on ‘gender ideology’
item.description: A whistleblower claims Biden's Education Department ignored a court order against enforcing Title IX changes regarding gender identity in schools. Empower Oversight is urging the Trump administration to investigate these allegations.

item.title: ‘Embolden Christ followers’: Counteract USA launches faith-based student ‘cells’ on colleges nationwide
item.description: 'Movement of Christians committed to changing their culture for the sake of the gospel of Jesus.'

item.title: Bill seeks to ban noncitizens from being eligible for in-state college tuition
item.description: 'My bill will put our students first by ensuring that only Americans are eligible for in-state tuition.'
